description: This file provides utility functions related to file handling and subtitle format recognition, including functions to ensure directory existence, save temporary uploads, validate subtitle extensions, and guess subtitle formats based on file extension and content inspection.

methods.name: None ensure_dir(path: Path | str)
methods.description: Ensure a directory exists, creating it with parents if necessary, mimicking 'mkdir -p'.

methods.name: Path save_temp_upload(data: bytes, dst_dir: Path | str, suffix: str = "")
methods.description: Save byte data to a uniquely named temporary file within a specified directory.

methods.name: bool allowed_subtitle_extension(filename: Optional[str])
methods.description: Verify if a filename has an extension that is permitted for subtitle files.

methods.name: str guess_subtitle_format(path: Path | str)
methods.description: Determine the subtitle format based on file extension and simple content checks.

ctags.name: save_temp_upload
ctags.pattern: /^def save_temp_upload(data: bytes, dst_dir: Path | str, suffix: str = "") -> Path:$/
ctags.signature: (data: bytes, dst_dir: Path | str, suffix: str = "")
